usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog, and ClickSend SMS announces a launch when “New Product” runs “Send MMS Campaign”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Send MMS Campaign” in ClickSend SMS
bestTemplate.why: A new product goes out as a picture message campaign through your ClickSend SMS account.

watchOut: “Send MMS Campaign” goes to a whole list, so every new product would trigger a campaign.
